result.instructions: Tools for ScrapeOwl, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many ScrapeOwl credits are left?"; "Extract the title and paragraphs from https://example.com after I confirm the vendor credit cost."; "Render https://example.com with JavaScript after I confirm the vendor credit cost.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ScrapeOwl data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run scrapeowl_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scrapeowl_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scrapeowl_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. scrapeowl_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: Read account credit, request and concurrency counters. Does not scrape a page. Vendor usage endpoint limit: 20 requests/minute.
